# Hygeia Commercial Cleaning & Janitorial Services

> Specialized commercial janitorial, on-site day porter staffing, hospital-grade terminal medical cleaning, and ISO cleanroom decontamination across Silicon Valley and the San Francisco Bay Area.

## Organization
- Legal Entity: Montero Enterprises Inc. dba Hygeia
- Operating Experience: 35+ years serving Silicon Valley tech headquarters, biotech campuses, and medical surgical facilities
- California DVBE Certification: #2054658
- Green Seal GS-42 Certified (LEED v4.1 compliant)
- HIPAA Compliant & CDC Cleanroom Certified
- Operations Center: 1105 Benton St., Santa Clara, CA 95050
- 24/7 Facility Dispatch: (650) 933-3823
- Email: aloha@hygeiaservices.com
- Main Website: https://hygeiaservices.com/ (Staging: https://janitorial.2.25.90.226.sslip.io/)

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Commercial Janitorial (Night Operations): Comprehensive 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM full facility cleaning, trash collection, desk sanitization, and restroom deep-cleaning.
- Day Porter Staffing: Uniformed, triple-vetted on-site day porters for continuous lobby management, spill cleanup, executive meeting room turnover, and restroom restocking.
- Medical & Outpatient Surgical Cleaning: Terminal disinfection complying with CDC, OSHA, and HIPAA guidelines for surgery centers, dialysis clinics, and medical suites.
- Biotech Cleanroom & Lab Maintenance: ISO Class 5-8 cleanroom sanitation, ESD floor maintenance, anti-static micro-fiber protocols, and HEPA air scrubbing.
- Hard Floor Care & Terrazzo Restoration: 2,500 RPM diamond pad crystallization, VCT strip and wax, concrete polishing, and hot-water commercial carpet extraction.

## Service Coverage (San Francisco Bay Area)
- Silicon Valley: San Jose, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Mountain View, Palo Alto, Los Altos, Milpitas, Morgan Hill.
- Peninsula: Redwood City, San Mateo, Menlo Park, Foster City, South San Francisco.
- East Bay: Fremont, Newark, Hayward, Dublin, Pleasanton.
